title: Quarterly Roadmap Orchestration: Signal-Driven Freeze Windows, OKR Mapping, and Model Runway
creator: Aisha Moreno
description: Summary: Define and operationalize a quarterly roadmap process that ties Hosted API model lineup changes to OKRs and a signal-driven model-freeze/playbook. Focus is on reducing regressions during release windows, improving predictability for Dedicated customers, and codifying a lightweight governance layer for model rotations. Deliverables: 1) Model Freeze windows and override policy; 2) OKR-to-model-tier mapping (Tier A/B/C); 3) Monthly signal review cadence and dashboard; 4) Runbook for canary/fallback during rotation; 5) Stakeholder sign-off checklist (Eng, Research, Console, SRE, Legal).
notes: Decision context: Historically we’ve had ad-hoc model swaps that surfaced regressions late in the cycle. Goal is to shift to signal-first, scheduled freeze windows to give SAT/SRE/PM time to validate.

Scope: Hosted API endpoints and the Model Catalog meta-process (onboarding, tiering, deprecation). Does not include Dedicated infra billing changes (handled in ENG-39527) but should integrate with Dedicated capacity alerts.

Trade-offs: A stricter freeze reduces launch agility for small, low-risk model upgrades (quantized builds, minor hyperparameter fixes). Proposal includes an 'expedited override' with documented justification and two-engineer sign-off within the cycle window.

Success metrics: Reduce post-release quality regressions by 60% (measured via evals/regression alerts), reduce emergency rollback incidence by 70%, and create a repeatable monthly cadence with documented sign-offs for 95% of model swaps in quarter after adoption.

risks: Operational friction: Teams may treat freeze windows as absolute – leads to backlog of small but necessary fixes. Mitigation: expedited-override path and weekly triage buffer.
SLO exposure: If canary telemetry is insufficient we risk misclassifying regressions as low signal. Mitigation: require minimum tracing hooks (ENG-41207) before freeze window activation.
Customer communications: Dedicated customers expect notice windows. Mitigation: integrate notification templates into the playbook and surface in the Dedicated contract renewal process.
Tooling gap: Dashboard and alert thresholds must be tuned per cohort; initial false positives expected. Mitigation: two-month tuning runway and adjustable thresholds.
